name: compliance-data-layer
description: CTC readiness, remediation and validation. Two deployables, forever.

pnpm.$comment: esbuild is vitest's bundler and needs its postinstall to place a platform binary. sharp is next's image-optimisation binary, same situation. Declared explicitly rather than left to an interactive `pnpm approve-builds`, so a fresh clone and CI behave identically.
$overridesComment: CI runs `pnpm audit --audit-level high` as a blocking gate. These are
transitive advisories with no direct dependency to bump, so they are
pinned forward here rather than by lowering the audit threshold.
js-yaml       GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m  merge-key chains -> quadratic CPU
via openapi-typescript > @redocly/openapi-core.
4.3.0 is the patched release and the newest 4.x; the range
selector leaves 5.x alone so this does not force a major
bump on a transitive consumer.
brace-expansion  GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg  unbounded expansion -> OOM
via eslint > minimatch and @redocly/openapi-core > minimatch.
Upstream patched only the 5.x line (>=5.0.8); there is no
fixed 1.x or 2.x, so the override crosses majors by
necessity. Verified against the full `make check`.
Both are build-time only and never ship in the sidecar image.
postcss  GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q + GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849  sourceMappingURL in a
CSS comment -> arbitrary .map file read. Reached through
next > postcss, which pins the 8.4 line. 8.5.18 is the first
release fixed for both; apps/web depends on ^8.5.25 directly,
and this override drags next's copy up to match.
sharp    GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj  heap buffer overflow in the bundled libwebp
on a malformed input image. An OPTIONAL dependency of next,
used only by the production image optimiser — but it is in
the lockfile, so it is in the audit. 0.35.0 is the first
fixed release.
